senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נָסַךְ)to pour (oil), to anoint; to oil.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:3">Dem. I, 3</cite> <he>שמן לָסוּךְ בו וכ׳</he> oil for vessels.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>שהגרדי סָךְ וכ׳</he> with which the weaver oils his fingers.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:1">Sabb. VIII, 1</cite> <he>כדי לסוך אבר קטן</he> as much as required to rub one small limb.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:10">Tosef. Ter. X, 10</cite> <he>לא יָסוּךְ כהן שמן וכ׳</he> a priest must not pour oil of T’rumah on a marble plate &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:11">Ib. 11</cite> <he>ואין סָכִין בו מנעל וכ׳</he> nor must you use it for oiling a shoe &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:5">Shebi. II, 5</cite> <he>סָכִין את הפגים וכ׳</he> you may pour oil on green figs and pierce them (to accelerate ripening); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="O00294"><he>סוּךְ</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="O00300"><he>סוּכָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>סוּכִים</he>, <he>סוּכִין</he>; <cite ref="O00302"><he>סוּכוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:3:6">Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>תאנים ס׳ וכ׳</he> figs which have been oiled and pierced.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 165:2">Yalk. Ex. 165</cite> <he>הסלע … מֵסִיךְ … כחיה שהיא מְסֶכֶת את בנה</he> (not <he>ממסכת</he>) the rock by their side anointed them with oil like a confined woman that anoints her child; <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 42:9">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLII</cite> <he>מניק … מניקה</he> (corr. acc.).
Tosef. Ter. X, 10 אין הזר … אע״פ שנ׳ ממנו the non-priest need not hesitate to rub it (on the priest’s body), although he himself (his hand) is perfumed thereby.—[Nithpol. נִסְתּוֹכָךְ, v. סָכַךְ II.]
